Compliance mapping (high level notes):
- SOC 2 (security + availability + confidentiality): Redwood Private provides VPC isolation, private control plane, audit logging (token-level request logs), and role-based access via SSO/SAML. Need: mapped control matrix (we requested Redwood SOC2 Type II + control mapping to Crimson Anchor policies). Also asked for retention controls for logs and proof of immutable audit trail.
- ISO 27001: Asked for statement of applicability and how Redwood’s operational procedures (change mgmt, incident response, supplier mgmt) map to Annex A controls. Need evidence of internal ISMS processes or third-party attestation.
- HIPAA / BAA: Key blocker. Must sign BAA before any PHI. Technical must-haves: customer-managed KMS (CMK) with key rotation, audit of key usage, isolated egress, encryption in transit and at rest, and ability to disable logging export to third-party unless agreed. Legal requested sample BAA terms (we provided Redwood template link).
- PCI considerations: Crimson handles card-on-file flows in a separate bounded context. For LLMs: requirement is to avoid sending PANs to models; where unavoidable, tokenize before ingestion. Ask: guidance on PCI scoped vs out-of-scope patterns, and whether Redwood supports tokenization or can integrate with Crimson’s token service. Also need network segmentation proofs and penetration test reports covering the Private deployment.

Technical asks & acceptance criteria:
- Architecture diagram (VPC subnets, peering, NAT, egress filters) — must include failover/DR region.
- KMS integration pattern: support for AWS KMS customer-managed keys or HSM (bring-your-own-key), demonstration that model cache/kv and persistent stores can be encrypted with CMK and that key usage is logged.
- Audit logging: per-request audit trail, log retention policy, tamper-evidence, and log export path to Crimson’s SIEM (S3 with restricted access).
- Data residency: ability to pin all processing to us-east-1 and restrict logging/metadata to same region.
- BAA: signed before POC ingest of PHI or identifiable data.
- Pen test & attestation: latest pen-test summary and SOC2 Type II report (or ISO attestation).
